fee_notes: Royalty is tiered: 8% on first $750,000 gross sales, 7% above $750,000.01, reverts to 8% next calendar year. Marketing fund capped at $10,000/year. Local marketing required at 2% of gross sales. Tech/call center fee $65/hr after Market Introduction Period.
